senses.gloss: to be perplexed; to fear, be anxious (corresp. to h. חרד).
units: Targ. Job XXXVII, 1 יתוה (ed. Lag. יִתְוַוהּ; some ed. יְתַיָּוא Pa.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 36:24">Targ. Jer. XXXVI, 24</cite> (h. text <he>פחד</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 33:24">Targ. Y. Num. XXXIII, 24</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 4:16">Targ. Koh. IV, 16</cite> <he>תְּוָוהוּ</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Vien. <he>תְּיָהוּ</he>, read <cite ref="V00165"><he>תְּוָהוּ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 28:66">Targ. O. Deut. XXVIII, 66</cite>, sq. <cite ref="V00161"><he>תָּוַהּ</he></cite> ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. <cite ref="V00161"><he>תָּוֵה</he></cite>).

Targ. Esth. V, 14 ת׳ לצפרא (ed. Vien. תַּוָּה Pa.) waited anxiously for the morning; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Emor 10 תַּוְהוּ כולי עלמא all the people were perplexed (marvelled); Yalk. Mic. 554 תמהו אומות העולם (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Pesachim 50b:7">Pes. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>תַּוְוהוּ ביה אינשי</he> Ms. M. people are disgusted with it (dislike the occupation), v. <cite ref="V00123"><he>תְּהֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:41">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 41</cite> <he>אַתְווּ תִוְהָא</he> ed. Wil. (ed. Lag. <he>איתיו תִיוְהָא</he>, corr. acc.).
